description: This file defines an Express router for admin-related routes in a backend Node.js application. It sets up route handlers for login, doctor management, appointments, and dashboard, applying middleware for authentication and file uploads.

methods.name: add-doctor
methods.description: POST route to add a new doctor, with image upload and admin authentication

methods.name: appointments
methods.description: GET route to retrieve appointments, with admin authentication

methods.name: cancel-appointment
methods.description: POST route to cancel an appointment, with admin authentication

methods.name: all-doctors
methods.description: GET route to retrieve all doctors, with admin authentication

methods.name: change-availability
methods.description: POST route to change doctor availability, with admin authentication

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: GET route for admin dashboard view, with admin authentication
